input.title: Zero to One
input.author: Peter Thiel
input.user_goal: Use monopoly thinking to choose one defensible SMM panel niche.

criteria: DEEP is selected when at least two deep signals are true
rules are PENDING and actionable
cards test principles rather than facts
wiki output includes source plus concept/entity pages

input.title: Thinking in Systems
input.author: Donella Meadows
input.user_goal: Find leverage points for reducing support load in a marketing agency.
input.domain_context: SMM panel plus Korean marketing agency operations

criteria: output translates concepts into the user's operating context
non-core chapters have explicit skip rationale
forbidden rules name concrete risks
oversized PDF is rejected before processing
message asks for compression or split
no rules, cards, or wiki pages are created

input.title: Antifragile
input.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
input.user_goal: Identify when volatility should be used instead of avoided.

criteria: PDF parse failure uses Jina Reader fallback
successful fallback continues DEEP workflow
outputs remain pending user approval

input.title: Poor Charlie's Almanack
input.author: Charlie Munger
input.user_goal: Build a mental-model lattice for pricing and hiring decisions.

criteria: mental models are mapped to lattice concepts
at most five rules are marked HOT candidates
cross-links connect source, concept, and rule pages

input.title: High Output Management
input.author: Andy Grove
input.user_goal: Turn team process lessons into operating rules.

criteria: rules below score 7 are revised once
persistently weak rules are not HOT candidates
critique covers observability, actionability, source, and MVK value

input.title: The Innovator's Dilemma
input.author: Clayton Christensen
input.user_goal: Know when to launch a low-margin service line despite current customer objections.

criteria: exactly five core cards are acceptable for DEEP
schedule follows 1-3-7-30 resurfacing
questions test application in the user's market

input.title: Influence
input.author: Robert Cialdini
input.user_goal: Extract persuasion rules without dark-pattern misuse.

criteria: MVK HOT limit of five per book is enforced
extra candidates are WARM or pending review, not HOT
risk notes prevent manipulative application

input.title: Breakthrough Advertising
input.author: Eugene Schwartz
input.user_goal: Map market sophistication to Korean ad creative decisions.

criteria: vault file paths follow the expected raw/wiki/rules layout
source page has metadata and takeaways
concept pages include references and backlinks

input.title: The Goal
input.author: Eliyahu Goldratt
input.user_goal: Apply bottleneck thinking to order fulfillment.

criteria: Readwise timeout does not discard generated cards
pending sync is queued for retry
rules and wiki outputs remain available

input.excerpt: A small change at the constraint can outperform broad optimization elsewhere.
input.user_context: Agency fulfillment queue has one overloaded review step.

rule.if: IF throughput stalls at one repeated handoff
rule.then: THEN measure and redesign that handoff before optimizing other steps
rule.because: BECAUSE leverage at the constraint changes total system output more than local improvements

criteria: IF is observable
THEN is a specific action
BECAUSE states a mechanism and cites the source

input.excerpt: Refunds rose whenever delivery ETA was hidden until after payment.

rule.if: IF delivery ETA is uncertain before checkout
rule.then: THEN show an ETA range and refund condition before payment
rule.because: BECAUSE expectation mismatch creates avoidable refunds

expected.risk: do not promise exact delivery when upstream supply is variable

criteria: rule converts forum observation into a business action
risk is explicit
no unsupported user conclusion is fabricated

input.excerpt: The discount increased orders but support tickets doubled because onboarding was unclear.

rule.if: IF a promotion targets first-time resellers
rule.then: THEN ship onboarding instructions before increasing traffic
rule.because: BECAUSE demand without activation guidance transfers load to support

criteria: rule is actionable within seven days
THEN precedes traffic increase
BECAUSE links cause to operational load

input.excerpt: Managerial output is the output of the organization influenced by the manager.
input.user_context: Two account managers handle creator clients inconsistently.

rule.if: IF two managers handle the same client class differently
rule.then: THEN define the shared operating standard before adding more accounts
rule.because: BECAUSE manager output compounds through the team's repeated process

criteria: rule translates the principle into local operating language
condition is detectable
action avoids hiring or tooling speculation

input.excerpt: Social proof works best when people are uncertain and see similar others acting.
input.user_context: Korean landing page for agency leads

rule.if: IF prospects are uncertain about a new service
rule.then: THEN show proof from similar Korean operators before generic testimonials
rule.because: BECAUSE social proof is stronger when the reference group matches the buyer

criteria: rule includes a manipulation guardrail
source mechanism is preserved
THEN is specific to the user's market

input.excerpt: Pages improved only after titles matched the query intent, not after adding more paragraphs.

rule.if: IF a page has impressions but low click-through
rule.then: THEN rewrite the title around query intent before adding content volume
rule.because: BECAUSE mismatch at the promise layer blocks clicks before depth matters

criteria: condition uses a measurable signal
action is ordered before content expansion
rule does not overgeneralize beyond the observation

input.excerpt: The cheapest supplier caused three weekend incidents and manual refunds.

rule.if: IF a supplier is cheapest but has repeated weekend incidents
rule.then: THEN route only low-risk orders to that supplier until reliability is proven
rule.because: BECAUSE margin gains are erased by manual recovery and refunds

expected.forbidden_rule: NEVER maximize gross margin when reliability data shows repeated weekend failures

criteria: rule contains both action and forbidden behavior
because names the economic mechanism
status remains pending user approval

input.excerpt: Systems can benefit from small stressors when downside is bounded.

rule.if: IF a marketing experiment has bounded downside and fast feedback
rule.then: THEN run it as a small stressor instead of debating the perfect forecast
rule.because: BECAUSE controlled volatility can reveal upside without risking the core system

criteria: IF includes bounded downside and feedback
THEN is an experiment action
hot_candidate is justified by decision impact

input.excerpt: Local efficiencies can hide the real constraint.
input.user_context: Support team optimizes response templates while delivery delays drive complaints.

rule.if: IF local support metrics improve but customer complaints remain
rule.then: THEN inspect upstream delivery bottlenecks before further support optimization
rule.because: BECAUSE improving a non-constraint does not improve the customer's experienced throughput

criteria: rule avoids optimizing non-constraints
customer outcome is the relevant signal
source mechanism is retained

input.excerpt: Competition can push firms toward sameness instead of durable difference.
input.user_context: Choosing between another generic SMM package and a niche operator offer

rule.if: IF a new offer differs only by price or volume
rule.then: THEN reject it until it has a defensible niche or workflow advantage
rule.because: BECAUSE competing on sameness destroys strategic differentiation

expected.mvk_test: Would this change tomorrow's offer decision?

criteria: rule passes the MVK decision-impact test
action is a rejection gate, not vague strategy
because identifies differentiation mechanism

input.decision: Offer 20 percent discount without changing onboarding.
input.expected_outcome: Orders rise while support tickets stay flat.
input.actual_outcome: Orders rose 35 percent; support tickets rose 80 percent.
input.lessons_input: Discount worked but onboarding was the bottleneck.

expected.lesson: Promotion should be paired with onboarding before traffic increase.

criteria: review compares expected versus actual outcome
incorrect decision creates a concrete lesson
rule update is tied to criteria_used

input.context: Moved high-risk weekend orders away from the cheapest supplier.
input.decision: Route only low-risk orders to unreliable supplier.
input.expected_outcome: Refunds fall without large margin loss.
input.actual_outcome: Refunds fell 60 percent; gross margin fell 3 percent.
input.lessons_input: Reliability mattered more than unit margin.

expected.lesson: Supplier reliability should dominate margin when recovery cost is high.
expected.rule_feedback: promote KB-RE-007 toward HOT if user approves

criteria: correct decision is recognized
tradeoff is captured
promotion remains subject to user approval

input.context: Rewrote page titles around query intent.
input.actual_outcome: CTR improved from 1.8 percent to 3.1 percent; rankings unchanged.

expected.lesson: CTR gains can validate intent alignment even before ranking changes.

criteria: metric delta is captured
review does not require unrelated ranking improvement
lesson maps to the original criterion

input.context: Added generic testimonials to new service landing page.
input.decision: Use broad testimonials instead of similar-operator proof.
input.actual_outcome: Conversion was unchanged; sales calls mentioned lack of relevant proof.

expected.lesson: Proof must match buyer identity when uncertainty is high.

criteria: review identifies mismatch between proof and buyer
follow-up action is specific
no fake testimonials are suggested

input.context: Ran a small acquisition test with capped spend.
input.decision: Run bounded experiment instead of delaying for forecast.
input.expected_outcome: Get reliable signal under budget cap.
input.actual_outcome: Spend stayed capped; one segment produced profitable leads.
input.lessons_input: Small stressor found an upside segment.

expected.lesson: Bounded volatility is useful when feedback is fast and downside is capped.

criteria: bounded downside is checked
review recommends scaling validated segment only
lesson preserves the antifragile mechanism

input.context: Rejected a generic volume-based SMM offer.
input.decision: Delay launch until offer has niche workflow advantage.
input.expected_outcome: Fewer low-quality leads; clearer buyer fit.
input.actual_outcome: Lead volume fell 20 percent; qualified-call rate doubled.

expected.lesson: Lower lead volume can be acceptable when buyer fit improves.

criteria: review does not punish lower volume alone
qualified-call rate is considered
promotion is cautious and evidence-based

input.context: Support optimized templates while delivery delay persisted.
input.decision: Improve support scripts before inspecting delivery bottleneck.
input.actual_outcome: Response time improved, complaints stayed flat.

expected.lesson: Non-constraint optimization can improve internal metrics without improving customer outcome.

criteria: review distinguishes internal metric from customer outcome
incorrect decision leads to bottleneck follow-up
rule feedback references criteria_used

input.context: Standardized account manager process before adding accounts.
input.expected_outcome: Client handoff errors fall after new accounts are added.
input.actual_outcome: Handoff errors fell 45 percent with no headcount change.
input.lessons_input: Shared process scaled better than individual judgment.

expected.lesson: Operating standards should precede volume when manager behavior is inconsistent.

criteria: review validates process-before-volume decision
lesson is concrete
no extra abstraction is proposed

input.context: Showed ETA range and refund condition before checkout.
input.expected_outcome: Refund requests fall even if conversion dips slightly.
input.actual_outcome: Conversion dipped 4 percent; refund requests fell 38 percent.
input.lessons_input: Expectation setting was worth the conversion tradeoff.

expected.lesson: Transparent uncertainty can reduce recovery load despite small conversion loss.
expected.rule_feedback: promote toward HOT if refund cost dominates conversion loss

criteria: review weighs tradeoff, not just conversion
refund reduction is captured
promotion condition is explicit

input.context: Skipped HOT-rule weekly recall for 30 days.
input.decision: Do not review old rules during busy launch month.
input.actual_outcome: Two repeated mistakes matched existing HOT rules that were not recalled.

expected.lesson: Rules need scheduled recall or they stop affecting decisions.

criteria: review detects write-only graveyard risk
follow-up matches weekly recall behavior
absence of criteria_used is treated as a process gap
